from pathlib import Path
import ctypes,json,os,random,re,statistics,subprocess,threading

OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT=Path('/Users/lijie/source/goplus/wasmvm')
header=Path('/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk/usr/include/sys/resource.h').read_text()
body=header.split('struct rusage_info_v4 {',1)[1].split('};',1)[0]
fields=re.findall(r'uint64_t\s+(ri_\w+);',body)
class Info(ctypes.Structure):_fields_=[('ri_uuid',ctypes.c_ubyte*16)]+[(n,ctypes.c_uint64)for n in fields]
lib=ctypes.CDLL('/usr/lib/libproc.dylib',use_errno=True)
lib.proc_pid_rusage.argtypes=[ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_void_p];lib.proc_pid_rusage.restype=ctypes.c_int
names=['ri_user_time','ri_system_time','ri_instructions','ri_cycles','ri_pkg_idle_wkups','ri_interrupt_wkups','ri_phys_footprint','ri_lifetime_max_phys_footprint','ri_runnable_time']
def snapshot(pid):
 info=Info();result=lib.proc_pid_rusage(pid,4,ctypes.byref(info))
 if result:raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(),'proc_pid_rusage')
 return {n:int(getattr(info,n)) for n in names}
assert snapshot(os.getpid())['ri_user_time']>0
class Timebase(ctypes.Structure):
 _fields_=[('numer',ctypes.c_uint32),('denom',ctypes.c_uint32)]
system=ctypes.CDLL('/usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib')
system.mach_timebase_info.argtypes=[ctypes.POINTER(Timebase)]
system.mach_timebase_info.restype=ctypes.c_int
clockbase=Timebase()
assert system.mach_timebase_info(ctypes.byref(clockbase))==0
tickNanoseconds=clockbase.numer/clockbase.denom

import hashlib,time
variants=[('base',str(OUT.parent/'base-go-runner'),4),('head',str(OUT.parent/'head-go-runner'),4)]
ref=ROOT/'artifacts/protocol-cost-20261112/output-screen/wasmtime-go-runner'
plan=dict(blocks=20,seed=2026112483,variants=variants,scope='Exact-source465f2c9 versus onepointeridentity check in valuePlanTransitionCost. Identical immutable plan mappings have zero transition cost; omit redundant map walks only. No codegen strategy, eligibility or generated machinecode change. Full validation/limits/checks retained. All compile and preparation separated from warm execution. Same runtime/guest/publicCompile marker harness, Go1.27.3 Clang22.1.8 GOMAXPROCS4, production checks/fuelpolicies unchanged. PublicCompile+bounded marker CPU excludes startup/load/instantiate/firstcall/cleanup. Wasmtime48.0.1 Rustinternalcompilewall only, isolatedreferenceCPU unavailable.20randomized freshprocessblocks withindependentA/Aaliases,2fullycheckedHTTPresponses everyprocess. No owned overlappingbuild/test/profile/pruning; record controls, not all-target fullportfolio acceptance.')
assert not(OUT/'rows.jsonl').exists();(OUT/'plan.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan,indent=2)+'\n')
rng=random.Random(plan['seed']);rows=[]
for block in range(plan['blocks']):
 order=[(label,binary,n,alias)for label,binary,n in variants for alias in ('','-aa')]+[('wasmtime',str(ref),4,alias)for alias in ('','-aa')];rng.shuffle(order)
 for label,binary,n,alias in order:
  reference=label=='wasmtime';binary=Path(binary)if reference or binary.startswith('/') else OUT/(binary+'-go-runner')
  command=[str(binary),'--engine','wasmtime'if reference else'wasmvm','--backend','compiler'if reference else'native','--wasm',str(ROOT/'pkg/wasi/preview3/testdata/world-rust-http.wasm'),'--payload-bytes','16','--expected','1757737011','--workers','1','--clients','1','--requests','1','--samples','1','--warmups','0']
  if not reference:command+=['--response-mode','buffered','--request-mode','snapshot']
  env=dict(os.environ,GOMAXPROCS=str(n));env.pop('WASMVM_INTERLEAVE',None)
  if not reference:env['WASMVM_COMPILE_PHASE']='1'
  started=time.perf_counter_ns();proc=subprocess.Popen(command,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,env=env);timer=threading.Timer(30,proc.kill);timer.start()
  try:
   assert json.loads(proc.stdout.readline())=={'ready':True};ready=time.perf_counter_ns()-started;proc.stdin.write('run\n');proc.stdin.flush()
   before=after=None
   if not reference:
    assert json.loads(proc.stdout.readline())=={'compilePhase':'compile'};before=snapshot(proc.pid);proc.stdin.write('phase\n');proc.stdin.flush()
    assert json.loads(proc.stdout.readline())=={'compilePhase':'compiled'};after=snapshot(proc.pid);proc.stdin.write('phase\n');proc.stdin.flush()
   record=json.loads(proc.stdout.readline());proc.stdin.close();remaining=proc.stdout.read();stderr=proc.stderr.read();rc=proc.wait(timeout=10)
   assert rc==0 and not remaining and record['result']==1757737011 and record['warmResults']==[1757737011],(command,stderr,record)
  finally:
   timer.cancel()
   if proc.poll()is None:proc.kill();proc.wait()
  row=dict(block=block,id=label+alias,command=command,GOMAXPROCS=n,readyNs=ready,wallNs=time.perf_counter_ns()-started,compileMs=record['phasesNs']['compileValidate']/1e6,record=record,stderr=stderr)
  if before:
   row.update(before=before,after=after,cpuMs=((after['ri_user_time']-before['ri_user_time'])+(after['ri_system_time']-before['ri_system_time']))*tickNanoseconds/1e6,instructions=after['ri_instructions']-before['ri_instructions'])
  with(OUT/'rows.jsonl').open('a')as f:f.write(json.dumps(row)+'\n')
  rows.append(row);print(block,row['id'],'compileMs',round(row['compileMs'],2),'CPUms',round(row.get('cpuMs',0),2),flush=True)
summary={label+alias:{k:statistics.median(row[k]for row in rows if row['id']==label+alias)for k in ('compileMs',)if all(k in row for row in rows if row['id']==label+alias)}for label in ('base','head','wasmtime')for alias in ('','-aa')}
for name in summary:
 if name.startswith('wasmtime'):continue
 for k in ('cpuMs','instructions'):summary[name][k]=statistics.median(row[k]for row in rows if row['id']==name)
(OUT/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(plan=plan,summary=summary),indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(summary),flush=True)
